evidence.limits: whisper.srt not available at coding time; speech coded from burned-in captions (hook complete at 4 fps, later captions at 1 fps). Reel is posted by @livnat_ur with @matan.nistor as co-author. Several comments say the couple later broke up; nothing in the video states that and it is not verified here. Comment counts approximate. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Couple's penthouse tour (two floors, rooftop terrace, kitchen, bedrooms, library) opened by a staged street question about how much rent they pay (33,000 shekels a month).
audience: general Instagram audience curious about luxury living; followers of Livnat and Matan
caption_vs_video_note: Caption 'בואו לסיור בפנטהאוז שלנו' matches the tour. The video opens as a staged street interview rather than directly in the home; the cover still shows a different frame (couple on sofa) with text about moving into a penthouse for 33,000 a month.

opening.first_frame: Matan in a blue shirt and Livnat in a lace top and denim skirt, holding hands, walk along a plaza outside a tower in daylight, shot from the side.
opening.s0_1: Walking shot; yellow quote caption 'היי יואו אני מכיר אתכם!' appears at 0.5 s.
opening.s1_3: They stop and face the camera; caption 'היי' (white) at 2 s, then yellow quote 'מה זה אתם גרים פה???' from 2.5 s.
opening.s3_5: 'כן!' (3 s), 'כמה אתם משלמים פה שכירות?' (yellow quote, 3.75 to 4.75 s); he talks to camera.
opening.visual_hook: Staged street encounter with a passer-by asking about their rent.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken (machine transcript) from 0 s, matching the captions: greeting 0 to 1.6 s, 'מה אתם גרים פה?' at 2.4 s, rent question at 3.7 s; answer '33,000 שקלים' spoken at 4.6 s.
opening.text_hook: היי יואו אני מכיר אתכם! / מה זה אתם גרים פה??? / כמה אתם משלמים פה שכירות?
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: about 7 s ('אפשר לבוא לראות??' then 'יאללה, בוא תעלה!' at 9 s)
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: the greeting and question make sense without context, though the rent topic only appears at 4.25 s
opening.number_or_money_in_first_3s: no (33,000 is spoken at 4.6 s and shown at 5 s)

visual.subject_placement: Street: couple at centre; tour: Livnat walks ahead of the phone camera. Captions in the middle of the frame (about 55%).
visual.setting: Plaza outside a tower, building entrance, penthouse: double-height living room with library wall and chandelier, bar, rooftop deck with lounge and kitchen, kitchen island, wine fridge, guest toilet, stairs, upper-floor office, wardrobe, bathroom, master bedroom, library.
visual.color_contrast: Neutral grey, black, wood and white; yellow text on the quote captions, white elsewhere.
visual.props_and_gestures: Holding hands, Livnat points up at the TV (16 s), dances in the library mezzanine (50 s), arms spread in the bedroom (67 s); Matan's books on the shelf at 77 to 78 s.
visual.supporting_footage: None added; the whole Reel is one tour in camera footage. At 1:17 his book 'לשרוף את הספינות' and 'DO OR DIE' by Matan Nistor are visible on the shelf.
visual.visual_progression: 0 to 9 s street; 9 to 13 s lobby and elevator; 12 to 27 s living room and bar; 21 to 33 s rooftop; 33 to 44 s kitchen, wine fridge, guest toilet; 44 to 51 s stairs and mezzanine; 52 to 59 s office and wardrobe; 59 to 77 s bathroom, bedroom, library; ends 1:18 to 1:21 on the sofa.
visual.cover_matches_video: partly: cover shows the same couple on the sofa with text '33,000 לחודש' and a penthouse claim, the video's last frame is the same sofa scene.
visual.ui_interference: Captions at about 55% height, clear of overlay zones; no text in the top 14%.

editing.edit_function: Information and pacing: each cut moves to a new room matched with a caption naming it ('מנגל ובר סך הכל', 'מזווה ומקרר יין'). Little overlay effects.
pacing_changes: t=0 to 12s: street scene with cuts about every 1 to 3 s
t=12 to 60s: a new room about every 2 to 3 s
t=63 to 70s: fewer cuts (about every 4 to 7 s) as the book shelf appears
editing.ending: Both sit on the sofa, caption 'ועכשיו הגיע הזמן לשאול מה דעתכם ?' (79 to 81 s).
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: dense room-by-room details; the end asks for opinions, not a return to the start.

sound.delivery: Machine transcript shows continuous speech from 0 s: quick street exchange in lines of 0.2 to 1.5 s (0 to 8.5 s), then steady tour narration in 3 to 6 s sentences, 9 s to the end, with a short gap near 52 to 56 s (transcript unclear there).
sound.music: unclear (the transcript shows no lyrics; speech fills the track, so a bed track cannot be confirmed)
sound.sync: Each caption phrase matches a visual: e.g., 'מנגל ובר סך הכל' while a patio lounge is shown; cuts land on caption changes.

text.colour_coding: Yellow for quoted speech of the passer-by in the street scene ('היי יואו אני מכיר אתכם!', 'מה זה אתם גרים פה???'); white for the couple's lines and the tour narration.
text.placement: Centre of frame, about 55% height, 1 to 2 lines.
text.style: Bold white Hebrew with dark outline, small emoji inserted (🏠, 🍷, 😱); white-on-grey in the tour.
text.density_and_read_time: 3 to 6 words per caption, changing about every 2 seconds; easy.
text.language: Colloquial and brag-flavoured: 'חדר שינה עם שירותים ומקלחת צמודים', 'מיליונים רק על העיצוב והריהוט', 'והגבוהים בישראל'. Ends with a question.
text.caption_structure: One line: 'בואו לסיור בפנטהאוז שלנו🤯🔝מקווה שאתם מוכנים לזה..' with emojis, no hashtags, no CTA beyond in-video prompt.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew renders correctly; digits and shekel sign in '33,000₪' sit correctly; some captions have a leading quote mark placed on the wrong side.

story.setup: A passer-by recognises the couple and asks what rent they pay.
story.stakes: Whether the penthouse justifies the rent.
story.progression: The number is stated (33,000), they invite him up (floor 52), then a tour through nine rooms with price and design asides, including a library with his own book.
friction_points: t=0 to 9s: staged street skit (interpretation: comments call it staged, e.g. 'התכונן כל חייו לענות 33,000')
comments about a breakup show some viewers see the Reel differently with hindsight (not verified)

explicit_prompts.wording: ועכשיו הגיע הזמן לשאול מה דעתכם ?
explicit_prompts.spoken_too: said aloud at about 78.5 s, followed by 'תכתבו לנו' (machine transcript, 81 s)

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 43 comments, not representative. Most criticize: 'נשמע כמו פרסומת', 'לא עדיף לקחת משכנתא', staged encounter, vanity. A few defend ('כמה תגובות של קנאים'). Several mention the couple has separated, a fact not in the video.

conversion.cta_timing: 79 s (opinion prompt, spoken and captioned; 'תכתבו לנו' spoken at 81 s)
conversion.offer: none; his books are visible on a shelf but not promoted
conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: asking for opinions on a provocative home tour fits

pair_match.notes: n/a (top Reel, no pair in dossier)

rights_and_privacy: No third-party footage; the interior is a rental penthouse with Matan's books on show; the passer-by is off-camera.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: the same staged rent-question hook as other tours puts a large number in front of viewers and then pays it off with a fast room by room reveal; the closing prompt and the provocative rent provoke 737 comments (1.5 per 1K views).
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: reads as promotional and staged to many commenters, and the second half is a long list of rooms with little narrative.

standout_moments.what: '33,000₪' appears right after the rent question
'יאללה, בוא תעלה!' turns the street skit into an invitation
His own books shown on the library shelf: a soft product placement
Opinion prompt over the couple on the sofa
